memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypertension.
Patient reports occasional headache and fatigue. BP 162/94 mmHg, pulse 78, BMI 26. No dyspnea or chest pain. Lungs clear, S1S2 normal.
Plan: start antihypertensives, order baseline labs, ECG, review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.1 mg/dL (0.6-1.2), eGFR 62 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Serum potassium 4.4 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Amlodipine 5 mg OD
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Losartan 50 mg OD
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypertension.
Patient adherent, BP 138/84 mmHg, mild peripheral edema noted. No cough. Lungs clear.
Labs show creatinine rising to 1.3 mg/dL; continue amlodipine, telmisartan, losartan; hold hydrochlorothiazide pending review.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (0.6-1.2), eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2. Serum potassium 4.2 mmol/L.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 72, no ST-T changes, left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No evidence of ischemia or hypertrophy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypertension.
Patient off hydrochlorothiazide, BP 132/78 mmHg, no edema. Reports good exercise tolerance.
Creatinine stable 1.25 mg/dL, potassium 4.0 mmol/L. Continue current regimen, advise low-salt diet, review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.25 mg/dL (0.6-1.2), eGFR 54 mL/min/1.73m2. Serum potassium 4.0 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'I have been feeling occasional palpitations after climbing stairs, but they settle with rest. No chest pain.'

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-02-20 10:30 with Dr Suresh Menon for hypertension review and symptom evaluation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy: Penicillin - rash and pruritus noted after a course for upper respiratory infection in 2018. Avoid beta-lactams.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Cardiology, Dr Kavita Rao (St. Martha's Hospital) for evaluation of occasional palpitations and baseline ECG review. Include recent ECG and labs.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral outcome: Cardiology reports normal echocardiogram, no arrhythmia on Holter. Palpitations deemed benign, likely related to anxiety. Advise continue current hypertension management, reassure patient.
